tx: Although it may seem cost-ineffective to use lantadyme incense sticks if only using one or two potions, consider that overloads are untradeable potions that take a lot of time to gather all the materials for and make in large batches, especially higher tiers of overloads. With lantadyme incense sticks, the effective time sink of making overloads is extended by two minutes per dose for the tradeable lantadyme incense sticks. If only planning to use overloads for an hour, it may not be worth it to use 11 lantadyme sticks for one hour, but if doing extended trips or hours of combat or bosses, upkeeping lantadyme sticks extends the time investment of untradeable overloads for just the cost of the sticks.
